children.title: 2/ — Anchors vs data
children.body:
Your prices sit **~13.83×** above split-adjusted closes (chart normalization).

What matters for the replay: the **multiple**.

- User: 1396.4 ÷ 145.8 = **9.577×**
- Data: 101.00 ÷ 10.54 = **9.580×**

Δ = 0.03%. Shape matches.

children.title: 7/ — Caveats + close
children.body:
- Pattern extrapolation, not a forecast
- SMCI **Oct 2024 10:1 split** — compare multiples, not raw $ across eras
- ~98% vol → path won't be smooth
- Could rip then fade (peak was below close in P1)
